# Pawty

> Pawty is a gamified dog training app for iPhone and Android. Its line is "Train together. Grow together." It has 99 training skills in 5-minute sessions, 32 behaviour guides, training plans and a care calendar. There is no subscription and no paywall. It is made in Slovenia and available in 11 languages.

Key facts:

- Platforms: iPhone (App Store id 6805087382) and Android (Google Play package com.pawty).
- Languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Croatian, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian and Slovenian. The website has the same pages in each language under /de/, /es/, /fr/, /hr/, /it/, /nl/, /pl/, /pt/, /ro/ and /sl/.
- Training: 99 skills from sit and recall to tricks and agility, each with steps, common mistakes and a goal. Sessions last 5 minutes and are rated 1 to 5 paws. 3 perfect sessions in a row mark a skill as mastered. A 12-week puppy plan has review weeks built in.
- Motivation: daily streaks that freeze instead of reset after a missed day, 36 badges, experience points and a worldwide leaderboard.
- Behaviour: 32 guides on problems such as puppy biting, barking, pulling on the lead, resource guarding and recall, each with why it happens, what works and what makes it worse.
- Care: care calendar for vaccinations, grooming and dog school, food diary, equipment checklist.
- Method: positive reinforcement only, no aversive tools. Content is educational, not veterinary or behavioural advice.
- Business model: free, supported by banner advertising in the app and by affiliate commissions from the in-app Marketplace of pet retailers. The website shows no adverts.
- Data: stored with Supabase in Frankfurt, Germany. Website statistics use PostHog in the EU in cookieless mode.
- Operator: Matej Mesko, Slovenia. Contact: info@pawtyapp.com.
